verdict.rationale: LangGraph's interrupt() mechanism explicitly pauses graph execution at specific points (e.g., before a sensitive tool call node) and waits for external input before resuming via Command, which is the documented pattern for human-in-the-loop approval gates; GitHub docs also describe inspecting/modifying agent state mid-execution for human oversight. missing for 10: no dedicated first-party 'approve specific tool call' example/tutorial in the pack (only generic interrupt/breakpoint docs), and no independent/hands-on report confirming this exact tool-approval workflow in production.
